title: 2. Documents need to select records by relation

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: A document such as 'this problem and everything that evidences it' cannot be expressed without restating relations as container membership.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Decision 4f1e12e5 retired the relation-query section source (0 of 13 real sections) with a return trigger: a composition need neither live variant expresses. LiveWyer Insight met it on 2026-10-30: a problem dossier had to restate 296 evidences edges as membership of 23 containers (finding bbe2be46, srs#726 open question 3, srs#851 for the 33 container literals it then needs). The owner, 2026-09-10 (srs#688): "we had an unplanned query language. A large SRS repo will need a structured query language." SP-24 says what a query returns is opaque. One hop over one relation type was enough for every document in the demo.

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Does selection need more than one hop? Only one corpus has been measured. Under one-way-per-goal (decision 0750c62f, 'no third'), the return belongs in DiscoveryQuery as a relation axis, not as a derived container.
